import json,urllib.request
endpoint='{{workflow.parameters.mlflow-endpoint}}'
def call(path,body):
 data=json.dumps(body).encode(); req=urllib.request.Request(endpoint+path,data=data,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}); return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10))
try: exp=call('/api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/create',{'name':'mlops-cpu-synthetic-v1'})['experiment_id']
except Exception: exp=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(endpoint+'/api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/get-by-name?experiment_name=mlops-cpu-synthetic-v1'))['experiment']['experiment_id']
run=call('/api/2.0/mlflow/runs/create',{'experiment_id':exp,'start_time':0,'tags':[{'key':'workflow.uid','value':'{{workflow.uid}}'},{'key':'content.request_id','value':'{{workflow.parameters.request-id}}'}]})
open('/tmp/mlflow-run-id','w').write(run['run']['info']['run_id'])

import hashlib,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('/inputs'); entries=[]
for path in sorted(root.iterdir()): entries.append({'digest':'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'name':path.name})
pathlib.Path('/out').mkdir(); pathlib.Path('/out/staged-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'entries':entries,'schemaVersion':'v1'},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
